text: Given the elevated white blood cell count and your symptoms of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) plus abdominal pain, I need to check for organomegaly. Has anyone noticed a distinct lump in your neck or abdomen, or have you experienced easy bruising or bleeding gums? REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound, Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, significant weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, abdominal pain, and the biopsy results strongly supports this diagnosis. I will await the pathology report from the cervical lymph node biopsy to confirm the specific subtype.
